title: 3-Hour Adults Watercolour Painting Workshop – Singapore Themed / Floral
description: Pick your vibe — paint iconic Singapore landmarks like shophouses and Raffles Hotel, or go floral with sunflowers and peonies. Professional artist Kanchan Mehendale guides you through watercolour basics, layering, and blending over 3 relaxed hours. All materials provided, sketch prepped for you, and zero judgment on the finished product — just good vibes and a painting to bring home.
